identity_and_concept.description: Self-hostable clone of Google Gemini featuring an elegant, light-themed, French UI. Built as a sleek POC chat interface with model selection, document/image attachment handling with 20MB validation, progressive streamed response rendering, and crisp Google-inspired visuals.
identity_and_concept.design_archetype: Organic & Soft Tech (Swiss & Soft Utility Hybrid)
identity_and_concept.vibe: Airy, clean, intelligent, frictionless, responsive, Google Gemini aesthetic

instructions_to_main_agent: Build a complete single-page React app (POC) matching Google Gemini's light theme aesthetic in FRENCH.
Strictly adhere to LIGHT theme (white/slate-50 background, clean shadows, slate text). DO NOT add dark mode theme toggles.
Implement model select switcher with options 'Gemini 3.1 Pro' and 'Gemini 3 Flash'.
Implement file attachment picker supporting PDF, DOCX, TXT, MD, PNG, JPG, WEBP with exact 20MB max file size check.
If a file > 20MB is attached, display a clear French error banner (e.g., 'Le fichier dépasse la limite de 20 Mo').
Implement file preview chips with remove button and file size indicator inside or right above the floating textarea dock.
Implement streamed answer simulation using intervals/SSE generator so markdown text appears progressively token-by-token.
Include a 'Arrêter' (Stop) button during streaming that cleanly halts response generation.
Use react-markdown or custom light markdown parser for rich text rendering including code snippets with Copy buttons.
Ensure every interactive component has exact data-testid attributes as specified in data_testid_requirements.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Strictly follow the light palette and Google Gemini subtle visual design.
Ensure generous spacing (p-4 to p-8) and rounded corners (rounded-2xl, rounded-3xl).
Ensure all text is strictly in French as requested.
Never center-align the main app layout text globally; keep user and assistant messages visually distinct.
Ensure interactive states (hover, focus, active) have proper accessible focus rings and contrast ratios.
